name: ghostvue-workspace
description: Workspace for a Vue-first, headless-first UI component library.

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @ghostvue/playground build && pnpm --filter @ghostvue/docs build && playwright test
scripts.test:visual:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -v /work/apps/docs/node_modules -v /work/apps/playground/node_modules -v /work/packages/core/node_modules -v /work/packages/shared/node_modules -v /work/packages/themes/node_modules -v /work/packages/vue/node_modules -w /work -e HOME=/root -e COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 -e HOST_UID="$(id -u)" -e HOST_GID="$(id -g)" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble bash -lc 'corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm test:visual:update; rc=$?; chown -R "$HOST_UID:$HOST_GID" tests/e2e/*-snapshots apps/playground/dist playwright-report test-results 2>/dev/null || true; exit $rc'
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries && pnpm adapters && pnpm manifests && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm contrast && pnpm build && pnpm published-exports && pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:links
